paragraphs: Rav Adda bar Menyumi, Bava Kamma 31b.
Rʹ Gidel bar Menyumi—Berakhot 49a. Rav Huna bar Menyumi—Avodah Zarah 39a.

notes.text: This collective list does not establish that all ten sages shared a father. The checked texts explicitly name Rav Huna, Rabbi Elazar and Rabbi Chananyah. Gidel’s shortened title remains neutral here.
